title: kv cache: compacting allocator, paging and spillover eviction to reduce fragmentation and OOMs
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: Serving memory fragmentation and unbounded KV cache growth have caused intermittent OOMs on high-concurrency workloads and elevated tail latency when the cache allocator becomes fragmented. This PR introduces three coordinated changes to the KV cache subsystem: 1) a compacting allocator that reduces internal fragmentation by relocating cold KV entries within a shard to consolidate free space; 2) a lightweight paging layer to allow cold KV pages to be serialized and spilled to host memory (or optionally to local NVMe) instead of being retained on GPU, and 3) a global spillover eviction policy that operates at page granularity with an LRU-weighted score across shards to reclaim space predictably under pressure. These changes are controlled by feature flags and configuration knobs so we can roll them gradually in Dedicated and Private deployments.
commits: Add compacting allocator and page abstraction for KV cache
Implement host-spill serialization and page table integration
Introduce global spillover eviction policy and per-shard working set estimator
Metrics and telemetry for KV paging and compaction
Unit tests for pager, allocator and eviction policy
Benchmarks and regression tests for end-to-end workload
discussion: Ethan Brooks: Please add a configurable threshold for triggering compaction and clarify CPU overhead. Author: Added per-shard compaction_threshold_ms and a metric for compaction_cpu_ms, updated description and tests. Ravi Kapoor: Can we avoid serializing large KV entries synchronously on hot paths? Author: Pager uses async background worker threads and batching; added a bounded writeback queue and backpressure path to fall back to eviction. Sofia Martinez: Add telemetry to alert on excessive host spill rates. Author: Added 'kv_cache.host_spill_rate' gauge and alert rule in dashboards. CI flakes were observed on pager_integration_test due to timing sensitivity; tests were hardened to use deterministic clocks and CI rerun passed. Approvals: Ethan and Sofia approved after last fixes. Merge: squash merge after green CI and perf bench run on staging.
benchmarks_summary: Staging perf run (g4dn-like pool) shows peak memory usage for KV cache reduced by ~28% under 512-concurrent sessions, tail 99.9 latency for token generation reduced from 210ms to 165ms on heavy prefix reuse workloads, and OOM rate dropped from 3.4% to 0.2% across 24h soak. Throughput unchanged within noise (+1%). See docs/ops/kv_cache_paging.md for full numbers.
release_notes: Implemented KV cache compacting allocator to reduce fragmentation. Added host-spill paging and global spillover eviction to avoid GPU OOMs under high concurrency. New telemetry and config knobs for controlled rollout.
